checks: 321 event definitions and six native migrations
all indexed event references resolve to source lines
six removed flags resolve to captured original references
all definition edges and variable-reference line bounds resolve
all 382 common/events source hashes still match
verification.scope: Evidence integrity only; no runtime code or tests changed by this audit, no engine execution or timing equivalence claim.

reading_order: Find event -> variables in variable_index; event calls/callers use definition IDs. definition_index maps each ID to its direct repository path, symbol and definition line; calls/callers map definition IDs to source lines within the containing definition. Variable read/write/reset lines resolve through their definition ID. protected_reviews and six migration_review records provide manual semantics. Other labels are source facts, not migration approval.

method.scope: All 382 SB common/**/*.txt and events/**/*.txt files; no runtime code changed by this audit.
method.comments: Tokenised with quoted strings retained and comments excluded; commented dispatch examples are not callers.
method.references: Complete literal event-ID callers; variable writes, reads, changes, resets and literal parameter bindings across the scope. Helper graph is source reachability, not runtime execution or proof that an eligibility branch is reachable.
method.classification: Only manual cases assign reservation/outcome/receipt/episode meaning. Other labels describe actual operations or conservatively leave meaning unproven; identifier spelling alone is not classification evidence.
method.parameters: Literal RECEIPT/EXPIRY/etc bindings resolve referenced variable operations; unresolved parameter accesses are indexed separately. Runtime scope/parameter evaluation is not emulated.
method.scope_context: Write/reset contexts preserve enclosing scope keys; a country variable and a global variable with similar names are not treated as the same owner.
method.external_limit: Vanilla/CMF internals, GUI/localisation expression consumers and console calls are outside the complete SB common/events index. The six removed flags were also checked for literal GUI/localisation references in the retained before tree.

bookkeeping_reduction.performance: Source operation count only; no measured dispatch/pulse/time improvement.

native_timing: Engine pending; no guessed consumption point, transactional atomicity, save/load identity or performance claim. The six candidates retain option-time gameplay effects. No global native migration and no extra candidate migration.
protected: Kimberley shared reservations/results, Gaza resettable episodes, diamond survey on-actions, expiring receipts and settlement recovery remain unchanged.

classification_guide.input_or_indirect_state: No direct literal write found; reads/parameter bindings may refer to upstream or indirect state. Absence of a writer is not a redundant occurrence record.
classification_guide.shared_state: Read or written by multiple source definitions, or passed to a helper. Outcome/reservation meaning requires the linked contexts; no event-local replacement is established.
classification_guide.resettable_state: Explicit remove operations exist; no lifetime-only substitution is established. Reset paths are indexed, without assuming every reset enables a new episode.
classification_guide.value_or_reference: Arithmetic/list operations or an explicit non-boolean value/object/date are present; an occurrence bit cannot represent that data.
classification_guide.temporary_state: A write carries an explicit days/months/years lifetime; preserve expiration semantics. Its exact gameplay meaning is not inferred from the identifier.
classification_guide.settlement_recovery: Container-owned settlement dispatch state bridges JE outcome, chosen recipient and final settlement; distinct from a country event occurrence and cleared by settlement cleanup.
classification_guide.outcome: Records the winning side for the shared corridor and downstream settlement; seeing a notification does not encode that result.
classification_guide.unproven_state: No redundant event-local occurrence contract established from these operations; preserve the existing implementation.
classification_guide.temporary_receipt: Literal RECEIPT binding stores game_date plus DAYS, restores the remaining modifier term, and removes the expired receipt; event history cannot encode its expiry.
classification_guide.repeatable_counter: Written with value 3, decremented by the return helper, and cleared after the staged population return; not a boolean occurrence.
classification_guide.repeatable_episode: Set by this episode event, read by the monthly random-event selector, and removed by sb_gaza_clear_runtime; native lifetime history would outlive the authored reset.
classification_guide.reservation: Retains an owed outcome through delivery retries; cleared on settlement or authenticated cancellation.
classification_guide.resource_receipt: Guards the once-only remaining-resource grant; migrant-labour JE and later content read the granted state.
classification_guide.event_local_gate_candidate: One event owns the boolean writes and trigger reads; no literal reset/external reader was found in common/events. This source shape is a candidate, not timing or retry equivalence proof.

kimberley.reason: Alternative opener IDs share global reservation/result/resource state. Per-ID country or global history cannot substitute the shared transaction or its later consumers. Discovery remains option-time.

gaza.reason: Monthly selection tests the episode markers; sb_gaza_clear_runtime explicitly removes all four. Keep the authored episode reset instead of permanent country history.

diamond_surveys.reason: The repeatable survey is scheduled by sb_next_diamond_survey_year and sb_deliver_diamond_survey on-actions, with reserve/remaining/site/technology state. It is not a one-off event definition; ownership and reserves are rechecked at delivery.

delivery_receipts.reason: Pending, timed queued-attempt, held-popup and answered receipts are separate. Retry and stale-choice checks need that distinction; a permanent event history flag cannot identify an active delivery attempt.

settlement_recovery.reason: Shared corridor settlement is owned by its container/JE and can route to different country notifications. Winning-side state and pending settlement survive routing and cleanup boundaries; event history is neither result evidence nor the recovery receipt.

expiry_receipts.reason: Court concessions and Natal movement replacement keep expiry dates in parameterised RECEIPT/EXPIRY fields. Their arithmetic, remaining-duration reapplication and expiry removal are preserved.
